title: SafeLens: AI-Augmented Exploratory Analysis over Organizational Safety Records for Actionable Insights Generation
authors: Sanjay Das, Ryan Burchfield, Gavin Wiggins, Alan Guy, and Tirthankar Ghosal
description: SafeLens received the Best Demo Award at JCDL 2026 for AI-augmented exploratory analysis of organizational safety records. The work surfaces ranked risks, recurring patterns, and best practices to support evidence-backed operational review.
